question: How do I get a refund for a cancelled order?
answer: Refunds for cancelled orders go back to the original payment method within 5 to 7 working days. Zomato credits are refunded instantly.

question: How long does a refund take to reach my bank account?
answer: UPI and wallet refunds usually arrive in 1 to 3 working days. Card and net banking refunds take 5 to 7 working days depending on your bank.

question: Can I get a refund as Zomato credits instead?
answer: Yes. At the time of the refund you can choose Zomato credits, which are added instantly and can be used on your next order.

question: I was refunded less than I paid. Why?
answer: Delivery tips and certain taxes are handled separately. The refund breakup is shown on the order page under Refund details.

question: My food arrived late. Can I get compensation?
answer: If an order arrives more than 30 minutes after the promised time, open the order in the app and tap Help. Eligible orders receive credits or a partial refund.

question: Where is my order?
answer: Open Orders and tap the active order to see live tracking. If the rider is not moving for more than 10 minutes, tap Help to contact support.

question: The delivery partner cannot find my address. What should I do?
answer: Call the delivery partner from the tracking screen and share a landmark. You can also edit the delivery instructions before the order is picked up.

question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
answer: You can change it only before the restaurant accepts the order. After that, contact the delivery partner directly.

question: What if an item is missing from my order?
answer: Report it within 2 hours of delivery from the order page with a photo of what you received. We refund the missing item.

question: What if I received the wrong order?
answer: Report it from the order page with a photo. We will refund the order or arrange a replacement, depending on availability.

question: How do I cancel an order?
answer: You can cancel for free within 60 seconds of placing the order. After that, a cancellation fee may apply if the restaurant has started preparing it.

question: Can I order for a future time?
answer: Yes. Choose Schedule at checkout to pick a delivery time up to 7 days ahead, where the restaurant supports it.

question: Can I order for someone else?
answer: Yes. Choose Order for someone else at checkout and enter their name, phone number and address.

question: Is there a minimum order value?
answer: Minimum order values are set by each restaurant and are shown on the restaurant page and at checkout.

question: What is the delivery fee based on?
answer: The fee depends on distance, time of day and demand. The full breakup is shown at checkout before you pay.

question: Does Zomato deliver groceries?
answer: Zomato's grocery and ingredient delivery is available in select cities through Blinkit. Availability depends on your location.

question: How do I apply a promo code?
answer: Enter the code on the cart screen under Offers. Only one code can be applied per order, and it must meet the offer's minimum value.

question: Why was my promo code rejected?
answer: Codes can be rejected if they have expired, require a higher order value, apply to specific restaurants, or have already been used.

question: What does Zomato Gold include?
answer: Zomato Gold gives free delivery on eligible orders above the minimum value, extra discounts at partner restaurants and priority customer support.

question: How much does Zomato Gold cost?
answer: Gold is offered on monthly, quarterly and annual plans. Current prices are shown in the app under Profile, then Gold.

question: How do I cancel my Zomato Gold membership?
answer: Open Profile, then Gold, then Manage membership, and choose Cancel. Benefits continue until the end of the paid period. Fees are not refunded for the unused period.

question: Why was I charged a delivery fee on a Gold order?
answer: Gold free delivery applies only above the minimum order value and within the eligible distance. Check the bill breakup on the order page.

question: Can I share my Gold membership with family?
answer: No. Gold is linked to one account and one phone number and cannot be shared.

question: Will my Gold membership renew automatically?
answer: Yes, unless you turn off auto-renew in Manage membership. We send a reminder 3 days before renewal.

question: Which plan includes single sign-on?
answer: SSO is available on the Business and Enterprise plans of Zomato for Enterprise. The Starter plan uses email and password login.

question: Which identity providers are supported for SSO?
answer: SAML 2.0 providers such as Okta, Azure AD and Google Workspace are supported on the Business and Enterprise plans.

question: Does Zomato for Enterprise support SCIM user provisioning?
answer: Automatic user sync using SCIM is available only on the Enterprise plan. Business plan admins can upload employees by CSV.

question: How does Zomato for Enterprise billing work?
answer: Companies receive one consolidated invoice each month for all employee orders, with a department-wise breakup. Payment terms are 30 days.

question: Can employees set a daily meal budget?
answer: Yes. Admins can set daily, weekly or monthly limits per employee or per team in the Admin dashboard.

question: Can we pay a part of the order from the employee's own money?
answer: Yes. When an order exceeds the company limit, the employee can pay the difference with a personal payment method.

question: How do I add or remove employees in bulk?
answer: Upload a CSV with name, email and department from Admin, then Employees, then Bulk upload. On the Enterprise plan you can sync users automatically through SCIM.

question: How do I download GST invoices for my company?
answer: Go to Admin, then Billing, then Invoices, and download the monthly GST invoice. The invoice is issued to the company GSTIN registered in your account.

question: What support does each Enterprise plan include?
answer: Starter has email support. Business has chat support from 9am to 9pm. Enterprise has a dedicated account manager and 24x7 priority support.

question: What is the minimum team size for each plan?
answer: Starter needs at least 10 employees, Business at least 50 and Enterprise at least 500.

question: Can we restrict ordering to certain restaurants or times?
answer: Yes. Admins can set allowed time windows, such as lunch hours, and can restrict ordering to approved restaurants or cuisines.

question: How do I get usage reports?
answer: Admin, then Reports shows spend by department, employee and restaurant. Business and Enterprise plans can schedule reports by email.

question: When do restaurant partners get paid?
answer: Payouts are settled weekly, every Tuesday, for orders delivered in the previous Monday to Sunday week. The payout statement is available in the partner dashboard.

question: Why is my payout lower than expected?
answer: Payouts are net of the commission, taxes collected at source, ad charges and any refunds funded by the restaurant. Open the payout statement for a line-by-line breakup.

question: What commission does Zomato charge?
answer: Commission depends on your plan and city. Your rate is shown in the partner dashboard under Agreement details.

question: How do I change my restaurant's opening hours?
answer: Open the partner app, go to Outlet settings, then Timings. Changes apply within 15 minutes. Use Temporarily closed for unplanned closures.

question: How do I update my menu prices?
answer: Edit prices in the partner dashboard under Menu. Price changes are reviewed and go live within 24 hours.

question: How do I mark an item out of stock?
answer: In the partner app, open Menu and toggle the item off. It disappears from the app immediately and can be switched back on at any time.

question: How can I improve my restaurant rating?
answer: Keep preparation times accurate, pack food securely and respond to customer feedback. The dashboard shows the main reasons for low ratings.

question: How do I dispute an order cancellation charge?
answer: Raise a dispute from the partner dashboard under Orders within 7 days, with the order id and supporting evidence.

question: How do I advertise my restaurant on Zomato?
answer: Open the Ads section in the partner dashboard to create a campaign, set a daily budget and choose the audience area.

question: How do delivery partners get paid?
answer: Delivery partners earn per order plus distance and peak-hour incentives. Earnings are transferred to the registered bank account every week.

question: When do incentives get credited?
answer: Peak-hour and weekly milestone incentives are credited with the weekly payout, usually within 2 working days after the week ends.

question: What should a delivery partner do after an accident?
answer: Use the SOS button in the app first. The partner is covered by accident insurance; submit the claim from the Insurance section within 7 days.

question: What documents are needed to join as a delivery partner?
answer: You need an ID proof, a valid driving licence, vehicle registration, a bank account and a recent photo. Verification takes 2 to 3 working days.

question: How can a delivery partner change the working zone?
answer: Open Profile, then Zone, and request a change. It is reviewed within 48 hours and depends on demand in the new zone.

question: What happens if a delivery partner rejects too many orders?
answer: Frequent rejections can reduce access to peak-hour incentives. Partners are not penalised for rejecting orders for safety reasons.

question: Why was my account suspended?
answer: Accounts can be suspended for repeated order cancellations, suspected fraud or policy violations. You will get an email with the reason and an appeal link.

question: How do I change my registered phone number?
answer: Open Profile, then Edit, then Phone number, and verify the new number with an OTP. If you no longer have the old number, contact support with an ID proof.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Open Profile, then Privacy, then Delete account. Deletion is permanent and completes within 30 days. Active orders and unused credits must be settled first.

question: How can I download my data?
answer: Open Profile, then Privacy, then Download my data. We email a link within 48 hours.

question: Is my payment information stored safely?
answer: Card details are stored by our PCI-DSS compliant payment partner in tokenised form. Zomato never sees your full card number.

question: My payment failed but money was deducted. What now?
answer: In most cases the amount is automatically reversed within 5 to 7 working days. If not, contact support with the transaction ID.

question: Which payment methods are accepted?
answer: UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, wallets, Zomato credits and, in some cities, cash on delivery.

question: Why is cash on delivery not available for my order?
answer: Cash on delivery is unavailable for high-value orders, new accounts in some areas, or when the restaurant does not support it.

question: How do I report a food safety issue?
answer: Use Help on the order page and choose Food quality. Include photos. Serious cases are escalated to the Food Safety team within 24 hours.

question: How do you handle allergy information?
answer: Restaurants list allergens on the menu where they can. Always add allergy notes at checkout and confirm with the restaurant for severe allergies.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: Use Help in the app for chat support, available 24x7. For enterprise accounts, write to the dedicated support address in your Admin dashboard.

question: How long does a support ticket take to resolve?
answer: Most chats are resolved immediately. Tickets that need investigation are resolved within 24 hours, and complex cases within 3 working days.
